text: Kaza is a human thrill seeker and master wizard from Zendikar. She is a member of the Sea Gate Expeditionary House.

The was a medium tank used by Allied forces during World War II. The Sherman tank is seen throughout every Call of Duty game set during World War II (except the original Call of Duty). The tank is frequently seen providing support for the character by Allied forces. The M4 Sherman is considered the quintessential Allied tank of World War II. A Sherman Firefly tank can be used in Call of Duty 3 by playing the Polish missions. The M4 Sherman is also featured as a usable vehicle in Call of Duty: United Offensive's multiplayer, with its rough equal the Panzer IV. The same configuration was also intended for Call of Duty: World at War's multiplayer, however the M4 Sherman and the associated maps were scrapped.
Johann is a Human wizard boy from Eldraine. He is the apprentice of the archmage Gadwick.
Jyoti is an ancient elemental from the plane of Moag. Jyoti has a bond with the Dryads of the plane.

Kequia is a human psychometrist and mage-student, originally from Dominaria, who studied at Strixhaven University on Arcavios during the Omenpath Era. She is the daughter of Niambi and granddaughter of Teferi Akosa.

The is an American semi-automatic rifle featured in all World War II era Call of Duty games, as well as in Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and Call of Duty Mobile. This weapon is notable for its distinctive metallic "pinging" sound when an empty clip is ejected.
Kianon was Freyalise's bonded wolverine during the Ice Age on on Dominaria. Kianon sacrificed itself to destroy the Giant Spider Seklistis during Freyalise's duel with Jason Carthalion at Storgard.
Kresh the Bloodbraided was the mightiest human warrior from Jund, Alara. He wore a sword called Mage Slayer and commanded respect and honor, and caused bloodshed wherever he went.

Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy, is a human druid on the plane of Ikoria. Kinnan is a very young bonder, considered a prodigy among them. This is because while most bonders have only one monster companion, some like Kinnan can bond with many. The planeswalker Vivien Reid tried to ask him how he did it, but he just growled at her before riding off on the back of one of his beasts. Having grown up with monsters, Kinnan doesn't know much about manners.
The is an American semi-automatic pistol featured in almost every installment of the Call of Duty series and is the most frequently shown weapon in the series.
Kwaro was an aven veteran, a sentinel of Arashin, and Khan Anafenza's loyal captain of the guard in Tarkir's original timeline. It is unknown if he exists in Tarkir's new timeline.

Lily, sometimes referred to as Lily the White, was a wizard from Dominaria. She was the wife of Gull and had two children with him. Lily was born into poverty and prostitution, sold by her mother. She was supposedly hired by Towser to be in his harem. He hired her because she showed magical prowess by wearing an amulet that noticed any magic. When Gull and Greensleeves joined Towser's caravan, Gull fell in love with Lily. When Towser's convoy finally reached a coastal city, the three left his employment. However, the power-hungry wizard was scheming to steal Greensleeves' powers. He kidnapped the girls and teleported Gull to a remote tropical island. Just in time, Lily discovered her magical ability to summon Gull back. Towser was defeated, and afterward, along with Greensleeves, began to create an army to fight evil wizards.

Princess Lucrezia was a legendary human wizard, who ruled a city-state of the same name in south-western Jamuraa, four centuries after the Ice Age. Her city was constantly at war with the shah of Fysmatan, another port city on the shore of the Sea of Serenity. Lucrezian marines, an elite unit of her navy, were one of the most disciplined forces to sail the sea. During one of the numerous wars between Fysmatan and Lucrezia, the latter was also opposed by the Robaran Mercenaries, led by Adira Strongheart. After having found out that Lucrezian marines had enslaved a tribe of island natives to build a flotilla of warships, the Robaran Mercenaries attacked the marines and freed the slaves, selling the new ships to Fysmatan.

The is a Main Battle Tank used by both the United States Army and United States Marine Corps. It appears in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty: Strike Team, Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.

Lurrus of the Dream-Den is a female cat nightmare from the plane of Ikoria. Lurrus makes its den in the Indatha lowlands. The planeswalker Vivien Reid stumbled upon its lair while exploring, and found a litter of adorable nightmare kittens inside. Lurrus apparently has the ability to appear and disappear at will, because when Vivien tried to take a closer look at the kittens, Lurrus appeared from a wisp of smoke. Vivien quickly made her exit. Lurrus fought in defense of Ikoria during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.
Dean Lisette is a human druid teacher at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.
Mairsil, known as the Pretender, was a power-hungry wizard, who was a member of the Conclave of Mages during the post-Brothers' War Dark Age of Dominaria.

The is a sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, and making a brief cameo in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. It is a semi-automatic weapon that is, in many respects, a scoped version of the M14.
The Marked Cleric was a healer on the continent of Golthonor on Dominaria.
Marrow-Gnawer () was a leader of a large gang of nezumi in the city of Numai on Kamigawa. He was strong, cunning, and overall exceptional for a nezumi.

Miriam is a human druid who arrived on Thunder Junction between 4562 and 4563 AR. She may be a member of the Atiin. On Thunder Junction, Miriam joined the Freestriders and wears their sun adornment on her armor. As a druid, she has great respect for nature, and she has access to magic that allows her to communicate with animals, as well as fortifying, strengthening, and protecting them.

The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It also appears as a mounted weapon in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Black Ops.
Medge is a mutated merfolk teacher, part of the Simic Combine on Ravnica.
King Suleiman was an ancient king of Rabiah before the Thousandfold Refraction, esteemed for his wisdom and the many Djinni and Efreeti he had imprisoned.
Storrev is a Devkarin elven lich and leader of the Erstwhile, a zombie faction within the Golgari Swarm of Ravnica.

The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered. It can also be obtained in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 via console commands.
Stephan, also referred to as It Came from Planet Glurg, is an alien ooze who resides in Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun.
Thatu Reiniger was a vampire lord and wielder of the Bloodletter on the plane of Innistrad.

Towser was an egoistic wizard interested in astronomy and astrology, living on Aerona (Dominaria). He was the main foe of Greensleeves and Gull. He hired Gull as a member of his traveling crew to tend his livestock and wagons. After he had gathered a group of wizards who were once defeated by Greensleeves, he forced her via the Stone Brain to be obedient and planned to kill her. After Greensleeves defeated him yet again she found a terrifying punishment for Towser. With the Coral Helm she took away his gift of doing magic. Tower used all colors of magic except white: blue (Unsummon, Mahamoti Djinn), green (Regeneration, Wall of Brambles), red (hydra, berserkers) and black (Pestilence).

The M40A3 is a bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance, Call of Duty: Heroes and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered. It is also available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, but only through console commands.
Thrasios, Triton Hero, is a legendary merfolk wizard from Theros.
Valthus was a Segovian Leviathan in the Golthonor Sea on Dominaria.

Varnel Buckara was the Master of the Orange House of Fentesk, in the city of Estark on Dominaria. He participated in the Night of Fire, the destruction of the House of Oor-tael. He was a very lascivious man, who loved being surrounded by beautiful and young women: in his harem he had more than fifty of them. He was killed by the Grand Master of Arena Zarel, when the latter decided to destroy the four Houses. Zarel cast a spell on Varnel, which caused him to age a hundred years in a matter of seconds, until all that was left of him were his skeletal remains.

The M16A4 is a burst firing assault rifle featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Heroes, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, and briefly in Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

Varena was one of the best fighters in the House of Fentesk in Kush on Dominaria. She was a lean, angular woman with flowing red hair. Varena was tasked by her House Master to test Garth's power, then quickly became his lover and friend; this caused a relation of strange friendship and rivalry with Norreen. She helped rescue Garth from Zarel's prison. In the last match of the festival, she was paired against Garth, who was forced to kill her. Luckily, she was revived by Hammen. She survived the Time of Troubles, having helped Garth, and became the new Grand Master of the Arena.
Voja Fenstalker is a massive white wolf, and the former companion of the elven evangelist Tolsimir Wolfblood of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica.

Warree Tarcha was a kithkin augur from the Shadowmoor. She was an old wizard capable of casting very potent protective spells based on white mana. She lived in the doun of Kinscaer. When Ashling the Destroyer attacked Kinscaer, Tarcha's magic was strong enough to keep her at bay. However, Ashling distracted Tarcha for a few moments by igniting her hair by surprise. Before Tarcha resumed her concentration, Ashling killed the cenn Donal Alloway and a few other denizens of the doun. Tarcha then used her power to teleport Ashling to the edge of the world, where she could not do any harm to the doun. Since Alloway's death, Tarcha was an Acting Cenn of Kinscaer. Later, Tarcha was approached by the fae queen, Oona, who offered Kinscaer her protection against Ashling in exchange for the kithkin support in subduing her. Tarcha reluctantly agreed, believing that she was doing the best for her people. Sadly, Oona's help meant killing Tarcha and everybody in Kinscaer with her vines and absorbing the kithkin mindweft power, as well as Tarcha's protective magic into her. Oona's simulacrum of Tarcha then greeted Rhys and his friends after their return and later battled Ashling.

The is a mostly semi-automatic rifle appearing as an assault rifle in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified, Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, as a sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance, as a tactical rifle in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, as a battle rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, and as a marksman rifle in Call of Duty: Mobile. It was also available in Call of Duty Online, but was removed from it.

Wryget was a Shadowmoor merrow, a skilled tideshaper, and a member of Sygg's pirate crew. He was spared by Jack Chierdagh when the kithkin attacked Sygg's crew. Later, he worked for Brigid Baeli. He helped to defend Mistmeadow and participated in the ambush of Ashling the Destroyer near Kinscaer. He survived the Maralen-Oona war, but his current whereabouts are unknown.
Vorinclex (Phyrexian: lornScs, IPA: [vornχlx]), called The Voice of Hunger, was the Green-aligned praetor of New Phyrexia.
Vikya, Scorching Stalwart, is a legendary New Argivian human warrior from Dominaria.

The (sometimes referred to as the M2 Fragmentation Grenade throughout the series) is a small handheld anti-personnel weapon in the Modern Warfare series, as well as in Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty: Mobile. It is designed to be thrown, and then explode after a short amount of time.

Zegana was a stately and reserved merfolk wizard from Ravnica. She used to be the Speaker for Zonot One and Prime Speaker for a time, fulfilling the role of guildmaster of the Simic Combine. She upheld the traditional way of the guild and its utopian philosophy. She was replaced by Vannifar as Guildmaster, and later murdered by Etrata while the assassin was under the influence of Trostani's mind control pollen.
Yedora, Grave Gardener, is a treefolk druid teacher at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.
Aphelia, also known as Viper Whisperer, is a gorgon assassin from an unknown plane.

The MG34 (Maschinengewehr 34) is a German machine gun featured in Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty: Big Red One, Call of Duty 3 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. It also makes a brief appearance in Call of Duty: Black Ops III, and is available as a mounted weapon in Call of Duty: WWII.
Lagorin is a mighty quickbeast from Alacria. Bonded with Caradora, together they led the Alacrian Quickbeasts team that competed in the Ghirapur Grand Prix on Avishkar.
General Kreat, also known as the the Boltbringer, is a goblin soldier from Ravnica.
Nekrataal is an obsolete creature type for a type of Human Assassin from Dominaria.

The is an assault rifle featured in various games of the Modern Warfare series, as well as in Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Heroes and Call of Duty: Mobile. It was cut from Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Ghosts.
Neerdiv, also known as the Devious Diver, is a merrow rogue from Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.
Princess Lucrezia was a legendary human wizard, who ruled a city-state of the same name in south-western Jamuraa, four centuries after the Ice Age.

Rafael Kayanan is a Filipino-born naturalized American comic book artist who began his career working for DC Comics on the title Firestorm. He worked for several comic book companies during his entire career. Kayanan is a martial arts master in the Sayoc Kali system. He was the artist of the Armada comic Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering, notable for its unique way of drawing spellcasting.
The MAS 38 is a French submachine gun featured in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One and Call of Duty: WWII.

Lin Sivvi en-Vec (also spelled "Liin Sivi") was the granddaughter of Tant Jova, the elderly leader of the Vec tribe on Rath in the time leading up to the Phyrexian Invasion. Sivvi was her given name, while Lin was an earned title meaning "striking viper" for her proficiency in battle.

80s Robot is a robot character who debuted in the 2011 film The Muppets. Unlike the principal Muppet characters, '80s Robot was designed and built by Legacy Effects. He lives in Kermit's mansion, working as a valet or manservant to Kermit after the break up of the Muppets. '80s Robot also functions as a chauffeur, and uses his databanks and search engine to locate the Muppet troupe using a dial-up modem. He uses slang from the era, and offers such dated beverages as Tab and New Coke to those he meets. As his name implies, the character resembles the many robots who dominated the toy, novelty, and pop culture landscape in the 1980s,[1] which include the Omnibot 2000 made by Tomy, and Nintendo's ROB accessory. In an interview with The Magazine, Kermit talked of '80s robot's career: ::Q: After the film, who got possession of the '80s robot? ::A: Possession? Oh no one “owns” the '80s robot. He’s independent, has his own agent and publicist and everything. From what I understand, he’s reading scripts and looking for his next project, which I suspect will be a remake of a sci-fi hit from the '80s. '80s Robot also made brief background appearances in the 2014 film Muppets Most Wanted. He was featured most prominently singing "Together Again" in the finale, and in a scene with Dr. Bunsen Honeydew and Beaker in which he's strapped down that was deleted from the final cut. A.R.F. (Autodoggie Robotic Friend) is a supporting character in the Disney Jr. animated series Puppy Dog Pals. He is a robot dog invented by Bob to spend time with Bingo and Rolly while he is away at work and to help clean their messes. He often accompanies Bingo and Rolly on their adventures. In his debut episode "A.R.F.", his main function was to clean up after Bingo and Rolly (strictly), but he has been upgraded frequently throughout the series.
The is a French bolt-action rifle featured in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One and Call of Duty: WWII.

Alexsandr Kallus also known as Agent Kallus is the secondary antagonist in the first half of Star Wars Rebels, and later becomes an ally of the Rebel Alliance in the second half of the series. Before joining the Rebellion, he was an agent of the Imperial Security Bureau, assigned in making sure that everyone remains loyal to the Empire and anyone who showed any whiff of disloyalty was eliminated. He is skilled in physical combat and rather than leading an attack from afar, he involves himself in the field. After being stuck on one of Geonosis' moons with Garazeb Orrelios, Kallus grew disillusioned with the Empire and began to operate as a Rebel informant until he defected to the Rebellion.

Abraham Rubin Hercules Benrubi is an American actor, voice actor, and comedian, who is probably best known for his role as Jerry Markovic on the long-running medical television drama . For Disney, he played Thor in the 1997 comedy film George of the Jungle, Arlo in the thirteenth episode of the second season of the 2011 television series Once Upon a Time, and Dan the Dentist in Kirby Buckets. He also voiced the General in the 2014 Disney animated feature film Big Hero 6 and did additional voice work for the 2017 special Olaf's Frozen Adventure and Lonnie Redshirt in Strange World. For Touchstone Pictures, he played Rinny in Crossing the Bridge, and Mose Harrison in Open Range.

Adriana Elena Loreta Caselotti was an American actress, voice actress, and singer, best known for providing the voice and physical modeling of Snow White in Walt Disney's first full-length animated film Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, in 1937. She also provided her voice for Donald Duck cartoons Modern Inventions, Donald's Ostrich, and Donald's Off Day as well as the Silly Symphony Toby Tortoise Returns. She overheard a phone conversation in which Walt Disney was asking her father, Guido, if he knew of any suitable voices for Snow White. She then approached him, suggesting herself for the role. After auditioning for the part in September 1934, she was offered the part and accepted it. She had previously been a chorus girl for MGM. However, after Snow White was finished, she never landed any starring roles in movies and shows, due to signing a contract with Disney that stated she will only use her voice on Snow White. She did, however, make uncredited cameo appearances in The Wizard of Oz, We Were Dancing, It's a Wonderful Life, and a short film called Hobo's Lady, written by and starring Snow White co-star Pinto Colvig. She continued to appear in several promotional spots for the company and for Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs and sign memorabilia. In 1967, Caselotti recorded "Snow White" dialogue for the Telephone Association of Canada Exhibit for Montreal's Expo '67 which allowed children to dial-a-conversation with their favorite Disney characters, including Mickey Mouse,
The is an American self-propelled gun developed during World War II and used by the US Army. The M12 can be seen in the Aachen campaign of Call of Duty: Finest Hour and is seen in Call of Duty: WWII.

Ajed Al-Gebraic is Genie's old master, who is very greedy. He used up all his three wishes and sold Genie to a Sorcerer for eternal life, but not eternal youth. He appears in the episode "Genie Hunt".

Aldrich Killian is the main antagonist of the 2013 Marvel film Iron Man 3. He was a scientist involved with Extremis, another attempt at the super-soldier serum, using nanotechnology along with Maya Hansen. Aldrich Killian was created by Warren Ellis and Adi Granov.

Alioramus is a tyrannosaurid theropod dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous of Asia. It was a swift, more slender relative of the bigger Tyrannosaurus Rex and had a long skull. It was a carnivore that preyed upon herbivore dinosaurs and other smaller creatures than itself. There are two species in the genus, Alioramus remotus and Alioramus altai.

The M1 Carbine (in some cases M1A1 Carbine) is an American semi-automatic rifle that appears in Call of Duty, Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty 2, Call of Duty 2: Big Red One, Call of Duty: Roads to Victory, Call of Duty: World at War, Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts, Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: WWII. It also makes a brief appearance in the Call of Duty: Mobile comics.
Agent Antoine "Trip" Triplett is a character in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.. Triplett is a Level 6 agent working with John Garrett, who helps Phil Coulson's team in the search for the Clarivoyant.
Archimedes is the tritagonist of Disney's 1963 animated feature film The Sword in the Stone. He is Merlin's pet owl who has the ability to speak like a human.

Artemis Fowl II is the protagonist of the 2020 film Artemis Fowl who lives in a giant mansion known as Fowl Manor. He is the son of Artemis Fowl I, who regularly traveled for work and sent him postcards for his fairy collection. After his father is kidnapped, Artemis hatches a daring plan to rescue his father, but discovers that his father was actually part of something much bigger than he ever imagined.
M9A1 Bazooka x2 is a Tier One perk that gives the player an M9A1 Bazooka and two rockets. It is effective as an anti-personnel and anti-tank weapon. It becomes available at level 4.

Attila is a supporting character in Disney's 2010 animated feature film Tangled. Along with Vladimir, he is one of the Pub Thugs' muscle, and wears a large metal helmet that covers his entire face. He has a tattoo of a cupcake on his right upper arm, alluding to his love of baking and his dream of opening a bakery.
Ava is a character in the Disney Jr. animated series T.O.T.S. She is a T.O.T.S. baby delivery stork. She is Mexican.
Ashley is a character who appears in Zombies: The Re-Animated Series. She is a witch who runs a Curse Shop in Zombietown and Dae's aunt and legal guardian.

The (also referred to as the M21 EBR) is a semi-automatic rifle appearing as a sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered, and as a marksman rifle in Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

Babyfier, also known as Experiment 151, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to turn entire populations into babies, causing planetary chaos; the antidote consists of two teaspoons of applesauce, one cup of milk, three mashed bananas, and a dollop of 100% Kona coffee. If the de-aged victims are left untreated, they will have to grow up all over again. His one true place is at the dog shelter, turning old dogs into adorable puppies, thus making them more appealing to potential adopters.

Balthazar Cavendish (regularly addressed as Cavendish) is a major character in the Disney Channel Original Series Milo Murphy's Law. He was a Time Traveler given the mission of protecting Pistachio nuts along with his partner (and best friend) Vinnie Dakota. He and Dakota were later banished to the present and lived as Alien Refuse Engineers. Cavendish later abandoned his job and erased Dakota's memories in order to search for aliens.

Bal Boa is a character from the Playhouse Disney, later Disney Jr. series JoJo's Circus. He is a sneaky contortionist snake with a talent for making number and letter shapes and one of JoJo Tickle's classmates. Bal Boa also has a knack for troublemaking, and thinks it's fun to coax JoJo and others into doing what they aren't supposed to do, and the kids are sometimes susceptible to his charms. Bal Boa is also an expert on harvesting squirting flowers by doing a trance dance.

The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, and Call of Duty Online. It also appears as a mounted weapon in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Ghosts. It was also cut from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered.

Ayam Aghoul, also known as the "Duke of the Undead", is an undead sorcerer and, a frequent nemesis of Aladdin and his friends in the Aladdin TV series. Aghoul is from the netherworld and often escapes to attempt revenge on Aladdin for banishing him to the realm of the dead.

Baron Blitz is one of the recurring villains of Teamo Supremo, and notably the first villain the series' titular characters ever went up against. He is a short, Napoleonic dictator with blue skin and a German accent who frequently schemes to take over the state. His origins are never explained. Blitz usually made attempts to take over the State by stealing money in order to gain power. In his last appearance, his goal expands to world domination. However, he always fails because of his continuous losses to Teamo. His minions usually consist of inanimate objects which he has brought to life by use of remote control, including wax statues, bronze football players, and audio-animatronics. Along with the Birthday Bandit, Blitz was the most frequently recurring of the Teamo Supremo villains, appearing in five episodes - "In the Beginning...", "The Baron and the Baby Brother", "Calling Captain Excellent", "The Baron's Blitz", and "Science Friction!", and also having a cameo in "The Will of the People".

Basil of Baker Street (or Basil for short) is the titular protagonist of Disney's 1986 animated feature film The Great Mouse Detective. A well-known brave detective, he solves many cases in London to help mice in need. One case of his that remains unsolved is his archenemy, Professor Ratigan, still at large in London, and Basil won't rest until the criminal mastermind is found and put in prison.

The is a submachine gun that appears Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS), Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War and Call of Duty: Mobile. It is also obtainable in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare through console commands.

Bella Pesky is the youngest of the Pesky siblings and is still in the stage of a maggot. Like her sister Maggie, she has pink hair, but she can only say "Gah" and "Goo". She can juggle, breakdance, and do ballet. Bella doesn't have a big part in any episodes, except in "Sister Act". In all the others, she's often just sitting at the dining table. Although she doesn't have any arms, she has her own fork and glass. pt-br:Bella Pesky

Bella is a very beautiful ballerina wooden toy with a Russian accent that dances. She is idolized by Lambie. She breaks her leg so Doc puts her leg in a cast until the next day, when Bella's leg was fully repaired.

William Gilbert Barron, better known as Billy Gilbert, was an American radio comedian, famous for his comical sneezing gags, who, for Disney, provided the voice of Sneezy the dwarf in Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, as well as Willie the Giant in the Fun and Fancy Free segment Mickey and the Beanstalk. It is believed by Animation Historian John Canemaker that Gilbert got the role of Sneezy by walking into Walt's office for his audition and sneezed five times, and Walt said, "Billy, you've got the job." Gilbert was spotted by Stan Laurel, who was in the audience of Gilbert's show Sensations of 1929 and became employed as a gag writer, actor and director for Fox Film Corporation. He found similar work at Columbia Pictures, as well as in RKO short subjects. He later starred in many movies, such as His Girl Friday, Seven Sinners, Captain Courageous, Tin Pan Alley, The Under-Pup, The Great Dictator, Valley of the Sun, A Little Bit of Heaven, Rosalie, Rio, Anchors Aweigh, and Five Weeks in a Balloon. On Broadway, he worked in several productions as an actor, writer, and director. These included acting roles in Fanny, The Chocolate Soldier, and Gypsy Lady, and his offstage work included The Red Mill, Sally, and Buttrio Square. In the 1950s, Gilbert worked frequently in television with shows, like The Red Skelton Hour, The Danny Thomas Show, My Little Margie, Andy's Gang, Shirley Temple's Storybook, and a memorable pantomime sketch with Buster Keaton on You Asked for It. The is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance, and Call of Duty Online.
Bizarrah is an evil genie and the main antagonist of Disney's MathQuest With Aladdin.

Carmen, also known as Experiment 123, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. She is designed to make victims dance until they drop with her infectious Latin beats.

Carl Weathers was an American actor, voice actor, television director, and former professional football player. He was best known for portraying Apollo Creed in the , Al Dillion in the 1987 sci-fi action film , Chubbs Peterson in the 1996 sports comedy film , a role he reprised in the 2000 fantasy comedy film , and an exaggerated, frugal fictionalized version of himself in the Fox sitcom . He also voiced Kirby in Balto III: Wings of Change and the God of Basketball in the series . For Disney, he voiced Combat Carl and Combat Carl Jr. in Disney/Pixar's Toy Story of Terror! and Toy Story 4. He also voiced Omnitraxus Prime in the Disney XD animated series Star vs. the Forces of Evil and portrayed Greef Karga in the Star Wars Disney+ series The Mandalorian. Celestabellebethabelle is a character in the Disney XD animated series Gravity Falls. She is a mystical but vain unicorn who resides in a realm exclusive to her species in Gravity Falls.

Christopher Robin is a character who first appeared in Disney's 1966 featurette Winnie the Pooh and the Honey Tree. He is the owner and best friend of Winnie the Pooh. With a vivid and youthful imagination, Christopher Robin spent most of his childhood in the enchanted forest known as the Hundred Acre Wood, where he would embark on a number of adventures with his toys. Chick Hicks is the main antagonist of the 2006 Disney•Pixar animated film Cars and a minor character in its 2017 triquel. After winning the Piston Cup, Chick presumably lost his racing career, when his fans turned on him for causing The King to crash. He is now the host of his very own talk show titled Chick's Pick with Chick Hicks, on which he primarily spends time insulting and bullying Lightning when Jackson Storm and the next gen take over the motorsports.

Chilly is a main character from the Disney Jr. series Doc McStuffins. He is a stuffed snowman who thinks he's a real snowman, and one of Doc's friends. He always gets check-ups because he thinks he catches silly ailments, starts to melt or breaks a bone.

It appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and is simply an M1A2 Abrams tank with the turret removed and replaced by a folding bridge.

Chips is a minor character in 101 Dalmatian Street. He is a seagull who lives in Cornwall.

Chen, Ping, Helen, and Lily, or The Aunties, are supporting characters in Disney•Pixar's 2022 animated feature film Turning Red. They are Mei Lee's relatives who all at one point had the red panda curse, before sealing them away.

Christy Carlson Romano is an American actress, voice actress, and singer, who, for Disney, rose to fame for her starring role as Ren Stevens in Even Stevens. She is best known for her voice work as the title character of the Disney Channel animated series Kim Possible, and made a cameo appearance as Poppy Blu in the live-action film of the same name. She also played Jennifer Stone in the Disney Channel Original Movie Cadet Kelly and voiced Yuffie in the video game Kingdom Hearts. Clooney is a very unlucky Leprechaun featured in the animated television series American Dragon: Jake Long.

Cloudy, also known as Experiment 320, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to depress others with constant rain. His one true place is raining on Mrs. Hasagawa's produce at her fruit stand, suggesting he may be one of her "cats".

Claire Temple is a Marvel Comics character who mostly appears in the Netflix shows set in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Claire Temple is one of the Night Nurses. As such, she has dedicated her life to use her vast medical skills and knowledge of medicine to heal superheroes. She is a recurring ally of the Defenders (Daredevil, Luke Cage, Iron Fist, and Jessica Jones). As befitting a Netflix character, she can be quite violent and aggressive when the occasion calls for it, being able to handle herself quite well in a fight. Claire Temple was created by Archie Goodwin and George Tuska.

Classic Loki is a character from the Marvel Cinematic Universe that appears in the Disney+ series Loki. He is a Variant of Loki that lived in his predetermined path on the Sacred Timeline, but managed to survive his final encounter with Thanos by using an illusion to fake his own death. After many years in self-imposed isolation, he decided to look for his brother, but was captured by the Time Variance Authority and sent to the Void. This version of the mythological Loki was created by Stan Lee, Jack Kirby, Larry Lieber, Don Rico, Christopher Rule, Violet Barclay, Chu Hing, Mike Sekowsky, Pierce Rice, and Syd Shores.

Colby Madden is one of the main protagonists of the Disney Channel original series The Villains of Valley View. He is a supervillain, posing as an ordinary boy. His supervillain name is Flashform. Like the rest of her family, besides Vic, Colby has superpowers, though he may never get the legitimate chance seeing how their family is in hiding from fellow supervillains and superheroes alike. He is the youngest son and child of Eva and Vic Madden. He is Jake and Amy Madden's younger brother. He is portrayed by Malachi Barton.

Count Dooku, also known as Darth Tyranus, is a major antagonist in the Star Wars franchise. Once a Jedi Master, being the former Padawan of Yoda and Master of Qui-Gon Jinn, Dooku became dissatisfied with the Order and the corruption in the Galactic Republic, and later fell to the dark side of the Force. After the death of Qui-Gon at the hands of Maul, Dooku became Darth Tyranus, the second apprentice of Palpatine, the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious. During the Clone Wars, Dooku served as the Count of Serenno and head of State of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, leading a pan-galactic secessionist movement against the Republic and the Jedi Order. As a ruthless Sith Lord, Dooku secretly plotted to kill and overthrow his master, unaware that Sidious had his own plans to replace him with Anakin Skywalker. As such, when the right time came, Palpatine had orchestrated a lightsaber duel between Dooku and Anakin, who defeated and subsequently beheaded Dooku at Palpatine's urgings.

Crossbones (real name Brock Rumlow) is an enemy of Captain America in the comics. In the film Captain America: The Winter Soldier, he is an assassin who works for Alexander Pierce and HYDRA as a sleeper agent within S.H.I.E.L.D. He later returns in Captain America: Civil War as a minor antagonist, where he meets his untimely demise. An alternate version of the character appears in Avengers: Endgame, when the Avenges travel to an alternate 2012. Crossbones was created by Mark Gruenwald and Kieron Dwyer.

Cora Mills (also known as the Queen of Hearts) is a character featured in the ABC series Once Upon a Time, and its spinoff Once Upon a Time in Wonderland. She is the main antagonist of the first half of season two, and is the mother to both Queen Regina and Zelena, the wicked witch. After framing her daughter Regina for Archie Hopper's death, Cora tries to rule Storybrooke and bonds with her daughter. Although temporally successful, Cora is later killed by Mary Margret in exchange for Mr. Gold's life, who has been struck by Dreamshade by Captain Hook. Cora's soul then resides in the Underworld for a couple of years until Regina travels there with Snow, Emma, David, Rumple and Henry Mills, to rescue Hook. When Cora learns Regina is there as well as Zelena, who has fallen in love with Hades, the lord of the underworld. Together Regina and Cora try to stop Zelena's romance with Hades and after some struggle bonding with her estranged daughter, Cora is able to restore Regina and Zelena's memories, to help remember the one time they felt like sisters. With her unfinished business - bringing the sisters together - now complete, Cora is able to leave the underworld and go to a better place.

The is a weapon that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified. In Call of Duty: Black Ops, it is classified as a submachine gun, whereas in Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified, it is classified as a handgun.

Crosshair (birth number CT-9904) is a minor character in Star Wars: The Clone Wars and a major character in Star Wars: The Bad Batch. As a soldier of the Republic's Grand Army, Crosshair was part of the elite team of Clone Force 99 composed exclusively of defective clones like himself and specialized in dangerous missions. Upon the activation of Order 66, Crosshair has been affected by the secret programming contained in his inhibitor chip like the rest of the regular Clone Troopers, subsequently making him a dedicated and ruthless soldier of the newly formed Galactic Empire. However, his team denies the Empire and refuses to follow him, leading the once tight-knit former brothers in arms to become enemies. Following some clashes with his old team, which ultimately resulted in his brothers offering him a chance to return to them, but which he rejected for his blind loyalty to the Empire, Crosshair continued to serve the new regiment, only to begin to realize how much Clone Trooper loyalty meant nothing to the Empire. Upon realizing the error of his ways, Crosshair turned on the Empire by killing his commanding officer, leading him to become a prisoner to be experimented on. After months of imprisonment, he managed to escape and reunited again with his former brothers in arms.

Corbin Bleu Reivers, better known as Corbin Bleu, is an American actor, singer-songwriter, dancer, and producer. He made his debut role as Austin in the 2004 spy comedy film . He also voiced Lou the toy giraffe in the 2011 computer-animated film . Additionally, he guest-starred as Mercutio in the Freeform drama series . For Disney, he played Chad Danforth in the High School Musical film trilogy, as well as Izzy Daniels in Jump In!, along with Keke Palmer. He also sang in the High School Musical franchise and recorded a song for his new movie Jump In!. Additionally, he appeared as himself in the High School Musical TV series. His debut studio album, , was released in May of 2007. His other Disney roles are listed below.
Daedalus is a recurring character from the Disney animated series Hercules. He is Icarus' father, known as a great inventor and is also the shop teacher at Prometheus Academy.
The M40 is a bolt-action sniper rifle in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS) and Call of Duty: Black Ops Mobile.
Professor Cumulus Isobar is a character from Magic Kingdom's Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. He is a traveling con-man claiming to be able to summon rain.

Daphne Duck is Gladstone Gander's mother and Donald Duck's paternal aunt. She has the same uncanny luck as her son.
The M35 is a truck utilized by the United States Armed Forces.

Daniel Davenport is the bionic younger brother of Adam, Bree, Chase, and Marcus Davenport. He has been living a normal life with an adopted family. He never knew that he had bionics until his siblings accidentally activated his chip while taking a group photo. It is revealed by Douglas that Daniel has an ability called Power Replication. He can touch someone and have whatever ability he/she has. When he touches another person, the old ability is replaced with the new one. After Adam and Daniel stop the leak of the Hydro-Loop's fuel tank, Douglas apologizes to Daniel for lying about his bionics out of fear that he would freak out. Daniel decides to give Douglas a second chance. Before Daniel leaves back to the mainland, Douglas tells him that he can come back anytime. His original name was Subject D as he was the fourth bionic human that Douglas created.

Dave Douglas is the protagonist in the 2006 remake of The Shaggy Dog. He is a workaholic lawyer whose job keeps him too occupied to spend time with his family. But when a genetic border collie bites him, he receives dog traits, transforms into a dog and his life turns upside down.

Dark Wizard is an antagonist and the final mini-boss found in Disney's Magical Quest 3. It is the mini-boss of King Pete's Palace, and has to be defeated in order for Mickey Mouse and Donald Duck to fight against King Pete.

The is a 20mm gatling gun that is typically mounted to aircraft. It is featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty: Ghosts and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered.
David "Dave" Secord is Kit's father in the Disney Jr. animated series The Rocketeer. He is a stunt pilot, which is where Kit gets her passion for flying.

Dean Portman is a fictional hockey player from Chicago, Illinois. He is an enforcer and wears number 21. Dean first appears in D2: The Mighty Ducks as part of the Team USA (Junior Goodwill Games) team. He is the team's heavy enforcer that gives the Ducks a physical presence on the ice. He is close friends with fellow enforcer Fulton Reed and one half of the "Bash Brothers." Like Fulton, he dons a bandanna around his forehead, which is worn under his hockey helmet and shares a love for metal music with the other Bash Brother. He is present in the beginning of D3: The Mighty Ducks to accept the scholarships from Eden Hall but chooses to not attend Eden Hall. (This news is relayed to Charlie by Fulton who suggests that Portman may have decided to not accept the scholarship because Coach Bombay would not be in charge any more.) Portman does return for the JV-Varsity showdown in the last 15 minutes of the film D3: The Mighty Ducks and brings much needed spirit to the Ducks. He is put in the penalty box for 2 minutes after bringing down one of the varsity players in a dive and retaliates by stripping in the penalty box. Portman tends to be rough around the edges, especially when he is first introduced in D2. Later, he is shown to be laid-back when out having fun and enjoys flirting with attractive women. He is portrayed by Aaron Lohr.

Dennis the Bunny, nicknamed "Mr. Cutie Patootie" by Candace, is a rabbit and a former agent of the O.W.C.A. who went rogue and attempted to hack into the mainframe of the organization. According to Major Monogram, he is a mercenary for hire and master of disguise, proven by several images of Dennis that are sinister, followed by his harmless "mindless animal" look.
The is an American medium tank that was used during the Cold War.

Dean Abigail Hardscrabble is a major character in Disney•Pixar's 2013 animated film Monsters University. She is a dark red dragon-like monster with millipede-like legs and red bat wings, who serves as the dean of the School of Scaring at Monsters University.
Diablo is the secondary antagonist of Disney's 1959 animated feature film Sleeping Beauty. He is Maleficent's pet raven and accomplice.
DiVine is a character in the Animal Kingdom that is heavily dressed in vines and plants to be camouflaged in the plant life and walks on high stilts.

The M320 GLM is a single-shot hand-held Grenade Launcher and secondary weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, and the handheld version of the M320. It was first shown in the World Premiere Trailer.

Don Diego de la Vega (portrayed by Guy Williams) is the main protagonist in the 1957 TV series Zorro. He is a young scholar whose alter ego is El Zorro. He is depicted as a former University student, newly recalled by his father from Spain to his home outside . Just before reaching California, Diego learns of the tyranny of Captain Monastario from the ship's captain, and realizes that his father, Don Alejandro (George J. Lewis), summoned him to help fight this injustice. Although he won medals for his fencing back in Spain, Diego decides that his best course of action is to conceal his ability with a sword, and to affect the demeanor of a milquetoast intellectual rather than a decisive man of action. His alter ego, Zorro, operates primarily at night, taking the direct action that Diego cannot. This deception does not always sit well with Diego, especially as it affects his relationship with his disappointed father. In reality, Diego relies heavily on his wits, both with and without the mask on. Later in the series, Diego emerges as a respected figure in his own right, a clever thinker and loyal friend who just happens to be hopeless at swordplay.

Din Djarin is the titular protagonist of the Star Wars Disney+ original series The Mandalorian, later also appearing in its spin-off series Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett. He is a reputed Mandalorian bounty hunter operating at the time of the New Republic some years after the fall of the Galactic Empire. During one of his hunts, he met a mysterious Force-sensitive infant named Grogu of the same species as Yoda nicknamed "The Child", who happened to be his target with whom he formed a close bond and to seek to protect at all costs, putting him in conflict with other bounty hunters as well as the surviving Imperial Remnant that had originally hired him. Din is an "adopted" Mandalorian, since he wasn't born on Mandalore. Despite this, after defeating the Imperial Remnant's leader, Moff Gideon, the Mandalorian then acquired ownership of the Darksaber thus making him the rightful ruler of Mandalore. Months later, Mando would finally surrender the Darksaber to Bo-Katan Kryze with full legitimacy.

Doctor Vulter is a villain featured in Mickey Mouse comics. He was created by Ted Osborne and Floyd Gottfredson in the story Mickey Mouse and the Pirate Submarine, published in the Mickey Mouse daily strip from September 1935 to January 1936. Dr. Vulter is an anthropomorphic ape, resembling a gorilla. He is a megalomaniacal pirate captain and mad scientist, somewhat modeled after Jules Verne's Captain Nemo character. Using a futuristic submarine and a small army of henchmen, he plagues the seas by stealing various ships which he aims to use for his plans of world conquest. His principal weapon is a machine in the form of a large claw which gives off magnetic-like energy: by placing it against a ship's hull Vulter can turn the whole metal ship into one large magnet which sticks weapons to the wall, making them useless. Vulter's Germanic-sounding name, his uniform and monocle, as well as his plans of world domination and militaristic gang, are obvious echoes of the Nazi menace of the time. After being defeated by Mickey, Vulter never appeared again in American stories. He was, however, used by Italian authors, starting with the 1959 story Topolino e il ritorno dell'artiglio magnetico ("Mickey Mouse and the Return of the Magnetic Claw") by Guido Martina (plot) and Giulio Chierchini (art). The MK46 is a light machine gun that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Heroes. It was first revealed in the footage released during Call of Duty XP.

Dolores Madrigal is a major character in Disney's 2021 animated feature film Encanto. She is the eldest child and only daughter of Pepa and Félix Madrigal, and the older sister of Camilo and Antonio. She was gifted with enhanced super hearing.

Donnie Yen (甄子丹) is a Chinese-American actor, who played Chirrut Îmwe in Rogue One: A Star Wars Story and Commander Tung in the 2020 live-action adaptation of Mulan. For Touchstone Pictures, he played Wu Chow in Shanghai Knights. Outside of Disney, his best-known roles are playing Ip Man in the Ip Man film series and Xiang/XXX in the third XXX film XXX: Return of Xander Cage. Regarding Yen's performance in Mulan, director Niki Caro stated that his prowess with a sword left her gobsmacked. She described that "One of my favorite moments on set was the first time I experienced Donnie Yen's martial arts skills in real life. As Commander Tung, he does a sword display in front of all the recruits and my jaw hit the floor."
Dug is one of the two tritagonists of Disney•Pixar's 2009 animated feature film Up. He is a golden retriver with a special collar that gives him the ability to talk.
The MK14 is a semi-automatic assault rifle that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty Online and Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.

Dupe, also known as Experiment 344, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to generate infinite clones of individuals, but his programming is considered a failure because the original's power is distributed evenly among the duplicates, resulting in them being inferior in everything. Luckily, it is possible for him to reverse the cloning. His one true place is making half-calorie shave ice cones with Slushy.

Drowsy, also known as Experiment 360, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to cause populations to fall into a near-permanent sleep by simply bleating; only spraying water in the victim's face will awaken them, and other experiments are less vulnerable to his bleats. His one true place is putting insomniacs to sleep.

Helen Parr (née Truax), also known as Elastigirl, is the deuteragonist of Disney•Pixar's 2004 animated film The Incredibles and the protagonist of its 2018 sequel. She is an elastic and dexterous superheroine who can stretch any part of her body to great lengths, and mold it into several shapes and sizes. Helen is married to Mr. Incredible (Bob Parr) and they have three children, consisting of Violet, Dash, and Jack-Jack.

Electra is Prince Hugo's second flying horse, who appeared in the Disney Jr. series Sofia the First.

Elliot, Amy, and Kurt are three young mischievous Sorcerers who appear in the Sofia the First episode "Substitute Cedric" as main antagonists and they're all students of Hexley Hall, the Sorcery School Cedric attended, and enjoy using their magic to cause mischief and mayhem.

Edsel Wallace Little, more commonly known as Eddie Little Sky, was Lakota actor who appeared in films for Disney in the 1950s, such as Westward Ho, the Wagons!, The Light in the Forest, and Tonka. He also was an Indian performer at Disneyland's Indian Village in Frontierland. Little was born on the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation in Shannon County, South Dakota to Oglala Lakota parents and attended the Holy Rosary Indian Mission school. He later enlisted in the U.S. Navy during World War II. After the war, Little found work in the rodeo circuit as a bull rider & bareback rider. Later, he went to Hollywood initially to be a stuntman before transitioning into acting. Becoming one of the first Native Americans to play his native roles in film and television, Little prominently portrayed warriors and leaders films, such as Chief Crazy Horse, Tomahawk Trail, Apache Warrior, Buffalo Gun, Cimarron, 7 Faces Of Dr. Lao, The Hallelujah Trail, Paint Your Wagon, Journey Through Rosebud, and A Man Called Horse. His television credits included Cheyenne, The Rifleman, Have Gun, Will Travel, Wagon Train, My Favorite Martian, The Virginian, Bonanza, NBC's Daniel Boone, Gunsmoke, Bat Masterson, Death Valley Days, Fantasy Island, and in several episodes of Gilligan's Island. Upon his retirement from the film industry in the late 1970s, he worked as director of the Oglala Lakota Tribal Parks and Recreation Authority. Little died on September 5, 1997 from lung cancer. The MI5 Director is the leader of the MI5 intelligence. She is heard in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. She is heard in the cutscene, driving in her car while MI6 calls her and informs the terrorist threat that will happen somewhere in London. She then calls Baseplate as she approves the SAS mission in London.
The Enchantress is a minor, yet crucial, character from Disney's 1991 animated feature film Beauty and the Beast.

Ercole Visconti is the main antagonist of the 2021 Disney•Pixar animated feature film, Luca. He is an athlete who has been a five-time champion of the Portorosso Cup, in which he prides himself for such achievements of his. He's also a passionate monster hunter, being prepared when there's a sea monster present within Portorosso.

Fa Mulan is the titular protagonist of Disney's 1998 animated feature film Mulan. She is the strong-willed and tenacious daughter of a war veteran, who strives to uphold her family's honor. When her father is called back into battle to defend China from Shan Yu, Mulan opts to protect him by taking his place under the disguise of a male soldier named Ping. Mulan is inspired by the legendary . She is the eighth official Disney Princess, the only one not to be of royal lineage either by birth or marriage. She is the last Disney Princess to be developed during the Disney Renaissance and also the 20th century.
The was a six-wheeled armored car fielded by the Allied Powers in World War II. It was set to appear in Call of Duty: World at War but was cut for reasons unknown.

Evil Alex is an evil version of the original Alex Russo that she created of herself only meaning to make herself nicer after being told by everyone to be more responsible as the family wizard. She is the titular secondary antagonist of The Wizards Return: Alex vs. Alex.

Felix, also known as Experiment 010 (and temporarily Oscar), is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to clean and sterilize everything in sight, but had a flaw in his programming that caused him to be unable to tell the difference between dirt and living things. Thus, he saw all living beings as giant, filthy germs needing to be sterilized until Jumba temporarily reprogrammed him into a dirt freak. He was captured by Gantu, but was rescued in "Snafu". Although his "one true place" was never depicted in Lilo & Stitch: The Series, he was eventually given one in the Stitch! anime, with him becoming a mobile recycling service.
Fanny is a ceiling fan and one of the major characters from The Brave Little Toaster Goes to Mars.

The M8A1 is a four-round burst rifle appearing as an assault rifle in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Strike Team and Call of Duty: Heroes, and as a marksman rifle in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.

Fennec Shand is a recurring antagonist turned anti-hero of the Star Wars franchise, making her debut in The Mandalorian. Upon the formation of the Galactic Empire, Fennec was a new member of the Bounty Hunter's Guild. Now a feared assassin working during the era of the New Republic, Fennec remained hidden on the planet Tatooine after the arrest of her employers where she crossed paths with the bounty hunter Mandalorian Din Djarin aka Mando, who was almost fatal to her until she was saved by Boba Fett with whom she now works as a partner.

Ginny is one of the protagonists from the Disney Jr. animated series SuperKitties. She is the leader of the team and the bravest member. She sports sharp claws that allow her to grasp onto objects and scale up walls.

Gorthan is a character and antagonist from the PKNA comic book series. Gorthan is one of the smarter Evronian scientists, maybe the smartest one, with an intelligence comparable to the greatest Earthen scientists, or even superior. Due to experimenting on himself, he has also become physically strong, though these experiments may have affected his psyche. His experiments got the attention of Emperor Evron and earned Gorthan the rank of chief scientist. One of his experiments included physical and mental changes to an Evronian general, turning him into the supersoldier Trauma. Gorthan has studied human culture, which causes him to develop an unacceptable level of individualism among Evronians. He loves reading Shakespeare and has developed a kind of affection to the human race, yet not to the level to betray his people (at first). In PKNA #10, after the Evronians suffer several defeats on Earth at hands of the Duck Avenger, Gorthan offers the now imprisoned Trauma a chance for freedom if he defeats the Duck Avenger. Gorthan monitors both fights between the Duck Avenger and Trauma, and witnesses Trauma's defeat. In PKNA#20 "Mekkano", he is forced to form an alliance with the Duck Avenger, after betraying his people and losing his energy storage tanks to a rogue, self-repairing robot (the titular Mekkano). Tracking it down, Gorthan is eventually assimilated with it and is captured by the Empire. It's implied that Mekkano may still function, so possibly the ship carrying Gorthan

The , referred to within game files as the HK416, is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and can be used in Call of Duty: Black Ops III using console commands. The M27 is also seen in the intro cutscene for the zombies map Classified in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.

Goose Lee (voiced by Robert Ito) is a one-time character from the show, Darkwing Duck. This master of martial arts taught Darkwing Duck the art of Quack Fu long ago. Master Lee appeared only in the episode "Kung Fooled". He is voiced by Robert Ito.

Guido is a supporting character in the Disney•Pixar Cars franchise. He is a resident of Radiator Springs and co-owns "Luigi's Casa Della Tires" with his best friend, Luigi who only understands his Italian accent. When meeting racecar Lightning McQueen, Guido gets to live his dream of changing a racecar's tires where he later on becomes an active member of McQueen's pit crew, due to his ability to change tires at a fast pace.

The Green Goblin (real name Norman Virgil Osborn) is a supervillain from Marvel Comics. He is an archenemy of both Spider-Man and Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man, the founder and CEO of Oscorp Industries, and the father of Harry Osborn. However, upon taking an experimental serum, he became the supervillain known as the Green Goblin. In the Marvel Cinematic Universe, Willem Dafoe reprised his role as Green Goblin in Spider-Man: No Way Home as the main antagonist, after appearing in the non-MCU Spider-Man film trilogy directed by Sam Raimi. The Green Goblin was created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko.

The MK12 SPR is a cut Sniper Rifle in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. It can be found in the local game files as a thumbnail for the Elite application. It appears to be a customized M4A1 with a RSASS scope, bipod, rails, longer barrel and a visibly shorter magazine.
Grand Pabbie (also known as the Troll King) is a supporting character in the Frozen franchise. He is a wise and elderly troll that rules the Valley of the Living Rock.

Greylock the Grand is King Magnus's Royal Sorcerer who appeared in the Sofia the First episode "Baileywhoops", voiced by Mitchell Whitfield. He was mentioned in "Cedric's Apprentice" even though he never appeared in the episode along with the others from Season One.

Gramma Tala is a major character in the Moana franchise. She was a wise, but eccentric storyteller of Motunui, where she was ridiculed as the "village crazy lady" for her beliefs. Tala dedicated the final years of her life to mentoring her eldest granddaughter, Moana, in the cultural traditions of their people. Upon Tala’s sudden passing, she was reincarnated as a manta ray and continued to guide Moana throughout her adventures.
The is a specialist carrier vehicle which evolved into a vehicle used to carry numerous missile and rocket systems.

Dr. Henry "Hank" Pym (known formerly as Ant-Man) is a superhero from Marvel Comics. He is a brilliant scientist, and is the husband of Janet Van Dyne aka Wasp. Pym was originally the first Ant-Man before being succeeded by Scott Lang. He is one of the main characters in the animated series The Avengers: Earth's Mightiest Heroes and in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, debuting in the 2015 film Ant-Man as the deuteragonist and returning in its 2018 sequel Ant-Man and the Wasp as the tritagonist. Hank Pym was created by Stan Lee, Jack Kirby, and Larry Lieber.

Hawkeye (real name Clinton "Clint" Barton) is a superhero from Marvel Comics. He is a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and founding member of the Avengers. Hawkeye has no real superpowers, but is the world's greatest marksman armed with a recurve bow. He has two sons named Cooper and Nathaniel, a daughter named Lila and a wife named Laura. He is also Black Widow's best friend. He made his first appearance in the Marvel Cinematic Universe in the 2011 film Thor, and starting with 2012's The Avengers, he became a protagonist, subsequently appearing in Avengers: Age of Ultron, Captain America: Civil War, and Avengers: Endgame. He and Kate Bishop are the titular protagonists of the Disney+ series Hawkeye. He left his retirement to fight in the Civil War, and after Thanos wiped out half of all life within the universe, including Barton's family, he took on the role of Ronin, a vigilante who sought out justice amongst the criminals who didn't perish. Years later, when everyone (including Clint's family) was brought back to life by the Hulk, and Thanos was killed by Iron Man, Clint returned to his retirement from superhero work. Hawkeye was created by Stan Lee and Don Heck.
Hester Hen is a character in 101 Dalmatians: The Series, who appears in the episode "DeVil-Age Elder". She is the town witch, who enchants DeVil-Ville.

The is an armored fighting vehicle, part of the Stryker family, that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2. Two named M1128's are seen during "Team Player" aiding the U.S. Army Rangers during a skirmish in Afghanistan. An exhibit of an M1128 can be seen in "Museum".

Hocker, also known as Experiment 051, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to spit acidic saliva that can eat through solid matter. His one true place is with Mrs. Hasagawa as one of her "cats".

Hista was a giant (and ancient) African rock python seen in The Legend of Tarzan. He threatened the gorilla family, and no one seemed able to fight him evenly. She had a history with Tarzan's gorilla family, having attacked them frequently many years ago, until disappearing later on. Having returned, she intended to make a meal out of anyone in her path.

Horace Horsecollar is an animated cartoon character created by Ub Iwerks and Walt Disney. Making his screen debut in The Plowboy on June 28, 1929, Horace is an anthropomorphic horse characterized as a boastful ham with a penchant for attention and showboating. His name is derived from the oversized plow collar around his neck, which he typically wears along with a bow tie and bowler hat. Horace regularly appeared in cartoons as Mickey Mouse's steed and sidekick. As a running gag, the character could morph between a domesticated and anthropomorphic horse, depending on the situation. 1930's The Shindig established Clarabelle Cow as Horace's girlfriend and stock screen partner. Though Horace's onscreen presence obscured following the advent of color, modern works like 2010's Epic Mickey and 2013's Get a Horse! have made active use of the character.
The M1927, also known as the Tommy Gun in an early trailer, is a submachine gun featured in the Zombies mode of Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.

Honey Buttowski is Kick, Brad, and Brianna's mother. She is infrequently at home, as she and her husband take their daughter Brianna to compete in beauty pageants. She is very caring and protective of Kick but although she's often worried about him, she acknowledges his daredevil nature, sometimes even helping him with his stunts. She was once a famous daredevil and speedboat racer called "Honey Splash". Honey was the one who gave Kick his trademark white jumpsuit as a present, to show him how much she supports him.
Indigo is a wicked witch and one of Lucinda's best friends in the Disney Jr. animated series Sofia the First.
Irma Lair is one of the five main characters in the animated series W.I.T.C.H.
