Jacob Marley is the long-deceased business partner of Ebenezer Scrooge. He is a supporting character from Charles Dickens' story A Christmas Carol and its many adaptations.
Jacques is a French exchange student from Norrisville High in Randy Cunningham: 9th Grade Ninja. He is turned into a monkey-like monster by the Sorcerer. He usually speaks with a French accent.

Jay is the main tritagonist in the first three Descendants films. He is the son of Jafar. He is handsome, punkish, and mischievous. Being athletic, Jay provides the "brawn" when he and his friends were invited to Auradon Prep. He is a thief, a con man, a handsome, quick-witted boy with charm to spare, whose lies are as beautiful and silvery as his eyes.
The M27-IAR is a light machine gun that appears in Call of Duty: Ghosts.

Jaguar is an antagonist and the first mini-boss in the video game The Great Circus Mystery. His first battle takes a place in the first level (The Haunted Circus), he later reappears in the final level (The Baron's Castle) as one of the two mini-bosses the player must defeat.

Jake Joseph Paul is an American social media personality, actor, musician, rapper, and professional boxer, who, for Disney, played Dirk Mann in seasons 1-2 of the Disney Channel series Bizaardvark and guest-starred in the Walk the Prank special "Talk the Prank with Jake and Logan Paul". Paul was born in Cleveland, Ohio. He began his career in September 2013, posting videos on the now-defunct video application Vine. After gaining fame on Vine and YouTube, Paul was hired onto the set of Bizaardvark, playing the role of Dirk Mann, a character who accepted dare requests that he would then perform. His older brother, Logan Paul, is also a YouTuber and actor and both appeared on Bizaardvark and Walk the Prank. On July 22, 2017, during the middle of filming the second season of Bizaardvark, Disney Channel announced that Jake Paul would be leaving the series. The announcement followed a news report from about public complaints from his neighbors in Los Angeles regarding the noise generated by Paul's pranks, parties, fire hazards, and the large crowds of Paul's fans congregating in their neighborhood. As a result of Paul's departure, Dirk was written out of the series and replaced by Zane and Rodney (played by Maxwell Simkins and Elie Samouhi, respectively) in the show's third and final season.

Janet Damita Jo Jackson is an American singer-songwriter, actress, and dancer, who is best known for her innovative, socially conscious, and sexually provocative records, as well as elaborate stage shows. In addition to music, she is also known for her various acting roles, such as Justice LaRue in , Professor Denise Gaines in , and Dr. Patricia Agnew in 's and its 2010 . She also played Millicent "Penny" Gordon Woods in the CBS sitcom (1977–1978), Charlene DuPrey in the NBC sitcom (1980–1984), and Cleo Hewitt in the NBC/syndicated show (1984–1985). For Disney, she contributed the song "I Know the Truth" with Elton John in the concept album Elton John and Tim Rice's Aida and appeared at the 2018 Radio Disney Music Awards, for which she won the inaugural impact award. Her song "" was heard in the television special Totally Minnie, and an interpolation of her song "" was used in the song "Joyful, Joyful" for the 1993 Touchstone Pictures sequel Sister Act 2: Back in the Habit. Her song "" was parodied by S. Khar Go as "Crawl Away" in the Bill Nye the Science Guy episode "Invertebrates". She was also mentioned in The Parent Trap III and the A.N.T. Farm episode "influANTces" (with Chyna Parks dressing up as Jackson in said episode).

:For similarly named arsenal, see SMAW and P.A.W.W.S. The MAAWS (Multi-role Anti-Armor Weapon System) is a free-fire laser-guided rocket launcher featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts and Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. In Ghosts it is also a 9-point (8 with Hardline) Support strike chain reward.

Jeremy Lee Renner is an American actor, singer-songwriter, film producer, musician, and former makeup artist. Some of his notable movie roles include playing Brian Gamble in S.W.A.T., William James in The Hurt Locker, James Coughin in The Town, William Brandt in the Mission Impossible film series, Aaron Cross in the Jason Bourne film series, and Gary Webb in Kill the Messenger. His notable voice acts in films are Swifty from Arctic Dogs and Sergeant First Class William James from Robot Chicken. For Disney, he played Hawkeye in Thor, The Avengers, Avengers: Age of Ultron, Captain America: Civil War, Avengers: Endgame, Black Widow, What If...?, Hawkeye, and the upcoming film Avengers: Doomsday. He also starred as himself in the Disney+ documentary miniseries Rennervations, and an alternate Hawkeye in the What If...? episode "What If... Ultron Won?".

Jiminy Cricket is the deuteragonist of Disney's 1940 animated feature film Pinocchio. He is an anthropomorphic cricket depicted wearing a blue top hat, black tailcoat, spats, and with a red umbrella always on his person. Jiminy was appointed Pinocchio's official conscience by the Blue Fairy, with the responsibility to guide the wooden puppet on his journey to become a real boy. Notable for being the original performer of "When You Wish Upon a Star" (which would become the trademark song for The Walt Disney Company), Jiminy has appeared alongside Mickey Mouse and Tinker Bell as a company mascot throughout the years.

Li Lianjie (Chinese: 李連杰), better known by his stage name Jet Li, is a Chinese film actor, film producer, martial artist, and retired Wushu champion, who was born in Beijing. He is a naturalized Singaporean citizen. After three years of training with Wu Bin, Li won his first national championship for the Beijing Wushu Team. After retiring from Wushu at age 19, he went on to win great acclaim in China as an actor making his debut with the film Shaolin Temple. He also went on to star in many critically acclaimed martial arts epic films, such as The One, Fearless, The Forbidden Kingdom, The Expendables trilogy, and the Dragon Emperor Han in The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor. For Disney, he played The Emperor of China in the 2020 live-action remake of Mulan.
The MATV is a 4-door armoured vehicle that appears in Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Mobile.

Jeff Gorvette is one of the greatest American racecars in the Disney•Pixar Cars films series, first appearing in Cars 2. Donning the stars and stripes of his country's flag, the #24 Corvette C6.R has proven his ability to succeed on the big ovals and the road courses of the Grand Touring Sports circuits. Having moved from his hometown of Vallejo, California to Indiana to be closer to the racing world, Gorvette's ability to accelerate at such a young age has turned hoods wherever he competes. His championships and number of victories are unmatched, making him a respected competitor-and legitimate threat-at the World Grand Prix."

James Albert "Jim" Varney, Jr. was an American actor, comedian, and writer. He was best known for his role as Ernest P. Worrell, who first appeared in a series of commercials popular in the United States, especially Nashville, Tennessee, and then later in a television show called Disney took notice of the character's popularity and produced a feature film entitled Ernest Goes to Camp, starring Varney as Ernest. He also played Phineas Worrell in Ernest Scared Stupid and Felix Nash in Ernest Goes to Jail. Varney's performing abilities led him to many roles both as an actor and voice artist. For Disney, besides portraying Ernest P. Worrell in the Ernest film media franchise, he was also known for providing the original voice of Slinky Dog in Disney/Pixar's Toy Story franchise. Shortly before work began on Toy Story 2, Varney was diagnosed with lung cancer and died while he was recording lines for Cookie Farnsworth in Atlantis: The Lost Empire, which was released posthumously a year after his death. Since Toy Story 3, his friend Blake Clark took over as the voice of Slinky. Varney was born in Lexington, Kentucky, the son of Nancy Louise (née Howard), and James Albert Varney Sr.. As a child, he displayed the ability to memorize long poems and significant portions of the material from books, which he used to entertain family and friends. When Varney was a boy, his mother would turn on cartoons for him to watch. His mother discovered that Varney quickly began to imitate the cartoon

Joey, Vinnie, and Bobby are three minor characters in Disney's 2008 animated feature film, Bolt. Vinnie is a green pigeon and the leader of the trio while Joey is a blue pigeon and Bobby is a purple pigeon.

The M4A1 Tech is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty Online; it appears alongside the standard M4A1. It is a highly modularized version of M4A1, with an upper receiver similar to the M27, along with different iron sights, handguard, and buttstock.

John Eric Bentley is an American actor and voice actor, who is best known for his role as Chief Coakley, Master Chief Petty Officer George Calloway, Cayuga Weps, Barret Wallace in Final Fantasy VII Remake(trilogy), and many other characters in the television series JAG. For Disney, he played Uncle Bill in several episodes of Pair of Kings, Judge Joe Barrett in Hannah Montana, Mr. President in a few episodes of Lab Rats, a Mummy in Wizards of Waverly Place, Uncle Marty in Hailey's On It!, and voiced Lucius Best/Frozone in the video game LEGO The Incredibles and Disney Speedstorm, provided additional voices in Kingdom Hearts III, and Mr. Von Carnegie in Spidey and his Amazing Friends.

Lady Bullseye is a Marvel Comics character that appeared in Hit Monkey, voiced by Reiko Aylesworth, and appeared in Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur, voiced by Miki Yamashita. She is a fierce assassin who modelled herself after Bullseye. Just like him, in her hands anything is a weapon, and she never misses. She is often allied with large criminal empires. Lady Bullseye was created by Ed Brubaker and Clay Mann.

Alexandra "Lexi" May Adams (played by Lindsey Black in As the Bell Rings). Lexi and Danny were childhood friends up until Lexi moved away about 10 years ago and re-met when she moved to his school in the second season. Lexi is a popular student within the school and is seen to be athletic, funny, smart, and to have a good fashion sense. Everybody thinks she's "awesome" especially when she uses magic tricks to disappear.

The MORS (Military Operated Rail Sniper) is a single-shot sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. It was also going to appear in Call of Duty: Mobile as an operator skill, but was cut from it.

Leo Richard Howard is an American actor, model, and martial artist. Beginning his martial arts training at the age of four and an acting career at the age of seven, Howard is known for incorporating his karate skills into his feature film and television roles; as "Young Snake Eyes" in the 2009 action film , as "Young Conan" in the 2011 fantasy film Conan the Barbarian and as Jack Brewer on the Disney XD comedy series Kickin' It. He also had a recurring role as Logan Hunter on Disney Channel's Shake it Up. Additionally, he played Troy West in Lab Rats. In his early Disney fame, he portrayed the title character Leo Little, the host of Leo Little's Big Show and Hart Hamlin in Zeke and Luther. He also directed the Gamer's Guide to Pretty Much Everything episodes "The Rock Band" and "The Rodeo".

Leilani is a character from the Disney Jr. series Doc McStuffins. She appears in the sixth episode of the second season of the series, "Leilani's Luau". She is a hula girl toy from Hawaii that hula dances when the sun hits her until been in a box for so long, she becomes slow and weak Doc learns the hula from Leilani.

Lenny is a supporting character in the 1995 Disney•Pixar animated film Toy Story and its 1999 sequel. He is a small binocular toy that formerly belonged to Andy Davis and helped the toys see from far distances by using him as actual binoculars.
The MD Turret is a vehicle in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile.

Lola Boa is, as her name suggests, a boa constrictor and often the voice of reason amongst Brandy Harrington's friends. She speaks with a heavy Spanish accent. While she often has great ideas Brandy believes her ideas aren't too bright, and Brandy secretly believes she is gross because she swallows rodents whole while they are still alive. However, Lola remains one of Brandy's best friends throughout the show.
Little Leota or The Ghostess is a character appearing within the Haunted Mansion.

Lumiere (which translates from French as "light") is the tritagonist in Disney's 1991 animated feature film Beauty and the Beast. He is the castle's charismatic and rebellious maître'd, who was turned into a candelabra by the Enchantress' curse.
The M4LMG is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty Online and Call of Duty: Mobile.
Lorenzo Paguro is a supporting character in the 2021 Disney•Pixar animated feature film Luca. He is a sea monster who is Luca's father.
M-O (meaning Microbe Obliterator) is one of the tritagonists in the 2008 Disney•Pixar animated feature film WALL-E.
The Magic Man is a supporting character and the overarching protagonist in James and the Giant Peach. He also narrates the film.

The M1 Irons is a DLC weapon in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It is a revolver classified under Special Primary Weapons. It was released on May 5th, 2015 on Xbox Consoles, and was released for PlayStation Consoles, and PC on June 4th, 2015.

Mace Windu is a character in the Star Wars universe, most famously portrayed by actor Samuel L. Jackson in the prequel films. However, Mace has been voiced by other actors in video games and other animated projects. Mace has appeared at all Star Wars Weekends as a meetable character, alongside Kit Fisto and Shaak Ti. He also appeared in Hyperspace Hoopla. Windu is a Jedi Master and member of the High Council during the final years of the Galactic Republic, who wields a unique purple-bladed lightsaber. Despite the Clone Wars causing him to question his most firmly held beliefs, he is a staunch follower of the Jedi path and was distrustful of Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker because he felt that he had dangerous potential. Towards the end of the Clone Wars, he learns from Anakin that Supreme Chancellor Palpatine is the Sith Lord Darth Sidious and attempts to arrest him, only to be killed by the Sith Lord with the help of Anakin himself, who then becomes Darth Vader. During the final battle in The Rise of Skywalker, Windu appears as a disembodied voice, along with other past Jedi, empowering Rey to face the rejuvenated Palpatine.

Machana is a bug from the Aladdin TV series episode "Sneeze the Day". He is known as the creator of the Orb of Machana; an orb that has the power to cure any genie ailment. Or rather, orbs, as Machana apparently created many.
The Magical Wishing Starfish a character who appeared The Little Mermaid episode "Wish Upon a Starfish".

The M160 is an assault rifle cut from Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare; it is loaded in the campaign memory. Although it was cut, it is briefly seen in the level "Fission", in the room after destroying the Titan, next to the dead bodies, and is unusable. It also appears in the Xbox One images of the Maximum Overdrive and Radioactive achievements, where it is seen being held by Gideon with an ACOG Scope. When obtained via modding, its HUD icon is that of the M4A1 from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.

Mabel Tanaka is the protagonist of the 2026 Disney•Pixar animated feature film Hoppers. She is a 19-year-old animal lover who hops her mind into a robot beaver to navigate the animal world in order to save the glade.

Macho Bull and Fulla Bull are the names of two respective adult male elephants who appear in the 2000 Disney live-action film Whispers: An Elephant's Tale. They are large adult bull elephants (hence their name) who fight to see who is the dominant male of his territory.

Madame de Garderobe is a supporting character in the 2017 live-action remake of Beauty and the Beast. She is an opera singer for the ball during the film's prologue at the castle. Her husband, Cadenza, plays the harpsichord. She got turned into a wardrobe after the Enchantress placed a spell on the castle.
: The M8A7 is a burst fire assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III.

Man-Thing (real name Dr. Theodore "Ted" Sallis) is a character from Marvel Comics. He is a scientist who was mutated into an empathetic swamp monster with mystical abilities. Man-Thing was created by Roy Thomas, Gerry Conway, and Gray Morrow.
Marnie Piper is the protagonist of the Halloweentown film series. She is portrayed by Kimberly J. Brown in the first three films and Sara Paxton in the fourth film.

Marshmallow is a supporting character in the Frozen franchise. He is an enchanted snowman created to serve as Elsa's bodyguard. Following Elsa's return to Arendelle, Marshmallow inherited her palace and now lives a peaceful life atop the North Mountain with his siblings, the Snowgies.
The M1928 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Vanguard.

Martha Wentworth was an American actress. Her vocal variety led to her being called the "actress of 100 voices". She worked as a voice artist for Walt Disney Productions, Warner Bros. Pictures, and Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Studios. Wentworth's long radio career began in the early 1920s. She played The Wintergreen Witch on The Cinnamon Bear radio program, Annie Wood and Mrs. Littlefield on Crime Classics, Ma Danields on The Gallant Heart. Turning to film roles in the 1940s, her most recognized film is that of The Duchess in several Red Ryder films. Her other film appearances included Oregon Trail Scouts, Bowery Blitzkrieg, Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, A Tree Grows n Brooklyn, O. Henry's Full House, Jupiter's Darling, Blackboard Jungle, The Stranger, The Man with the Golden Arm, Rock Around the Clock, The Daughter of Dr. Jekyll, Go, Johnny, Go! and The Beatniks. Her television credits included I Married Joan, The Loretta Young Show, Telephone Time, Lassie, Dragnet, The Millionarie, and Perry Mason.
Medusa is a minor character in Hercules: The Series. She is a lonely young gorgon, who becomes smitten with Hercules.

The Mayor of Halloween Town is a supporting character in Tim Burton's 1993 stop-motion Disney film The Nightmare Before Christmas. He is a self-proclaimed elected official who presides over the political affairs of Halloween Town. The Mayor is a literal "two-faced politician", bearing a double-sided head that flips itself depending on his mood.
The is a fully-automatic light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: WWII.
Mazzimo is a flying horse who appears in the Disney Jr. animated series Sofia the First. He is the older brother of Minimus.

Mayor Gerald "Jerry" Generazzo is the former secondary antagonist of the 2026 Disney•Pixar animated feature film Hoppers. He is a real estate developer and the mayor of Beaverton who planned to clear out the animals' habitats for human residential areas, but when his life was threatened by the animals launching a revolution against him, he is now forced to follow the orders of a girl telepathically controlling a robotic beaver (who unintentionally started the uprising) if he wants to survive.

Michael Clarke Duncan was an American actor, who was best known for his breakout role as John Coffey in the 1999 drama film (in which he was nominated for an and a ). He also voiced Sam the in the 2001 spy comedy film and its 2010 , Clydesdale the horse in the 2005 sports comedy film , Big Daddy, the leader of the Tinysauruses in , and Commander Vachir in ' . For Disney, he voiced Tug in the 2003 Disney animated feature film Brother Bear and its 2006 sequel, the Mean Lion in George of the Jungle 2, the Wolf in Air Buddies, and played Coach Little in an episode of the Disney Channel series The Suite Life of Zack & Cody. He also appeared making a speech in the park attraction Armageddon - Les Effets Speciaux, where he played "Bear" in the Armageddon film, and voiced an adult Wade in Kim Possible: A Sitch in Time, Mongo in The Proud Family, and Groot in the Ultimate Spider-Man episode "Guardians of the Galaxy", the episode being dedicated to his memory. Additionally, he portrayed Eli in Breakfast of Champions and Kingpin in the 2003 Fox film . The latter role was later played by Vincent D'Onofrio in the 2015 reboot TV series.
The (referred to as M1941 Johnson in the game files) is an automatic rifle that appears in Call of Duty: WWII.
Melody Keep is one of the protagonists (along with her brother Maxwell Keep) of the 2014 comic series Disney Kingdoms: Seekers Of The Weird. She is shown to be athletic.

Meteora Butterfly, used to be known as Miss Heinous, is a recurring antagonist in the first two seasons and first half of the third season of Star vs. the Forces of Evil, and became the main antagonist of the second half of the third season. She was the headmistress of St. Olga's Reform School for Wayward Princesses and is the Mewman/monster hybrid daughter of Queen Eclipsa. Meteora was reverted to infancy by her mother in the third season finale.

Miles Morales (also known as Spider-Man or Kid-Arachnid) is the second Spider-Man from an alternate universe in which his world's version of Peter Parker died in battle. Miles Morales was created by Nick Spencer, Brian Michael Bendis, Jonathan Hickman, Salvador Larroca, Clayton Crain and Sara Pichelli.
The is a heavy tank used by United States Army in World War II. It first appeared in a trailer for Call of Duty: WWII.

Mike Mazurki was a Ukrainian-American actor and former professional wrestler, who, for Disney, appeared in the Davy Crockett series as Bigfoot Mason, played Mountain Ox in The Adventures of Bullwhip Griffin, and made a cameo in Touchstone Pictures' Dick Tracy. Mazurki was born Markiian Yulianovych Mazurkevych in the village of Kupczyńce in present-day Kupchyntsi, Ternopil Raion, near what was then Tarnopol, Galicia, Austria-Hungary (now Ternopil, Ukraine). He and his family later moved to North America where he attended the LaSalle Institute in Troy, New York.
